svg.title: Horizon architecture
svg.desc: Ten source types feed a shared pipeline: collect and merge, route to one profile, analyze and select, enrich selected items, and render a briefing. Profiles define matching, scoring, and content blocks. Thick blue arrows show content flow; dashed orange arrows show profile rules. Runtime configuration controls sources, models, filtering, languages, and delivery. Outputs include Markdown files, GitHub Pages, email, and webhooks for Feishu, Lark, DingTalk, Slack, Discord, or custom endpoints. CLI and MCP tools invoke the pipeline.
